responsibility: Defines the ISO convenience interface for querying the last read result of a specified channel. It re-exports IOConsts.ReadResults and exposes a single channel-focused accessor, providing a lightweight public wrapper around IOChan read-status storage.
same_name_distinction: This .def file declares the thin ISO wrapper API, re-exporting IOConsts.ReadResults and the ReadResult procedure signature; the companion IOResult.mod merely forwards that call to IOChan.
